ocean_regions.name: Bay of Bengal
ocean_regions.description: Semi-enclosed tropical basin exhibiting rapid thermal warming, massive Ganges-Brahmaputra river freshwater discharge, stratification, and frequent severe tropical cyclones.

ocean_regions.name: Global Ocean (60°S – 60°N)
ocean_regions.description: Global non-polar open-ocean waters observing multi-decadal thermodynamic planetary heat uptake and upper-layer heat content redistribution.

ocean_regions.name: Equatorial Pacific (Niño 3.4)
ocean_regions.description: Primary index region for El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO), driving coupled planetary ocean-atmosphere teleconnections.

ocean_regions.name: Western Mediterranean Sea
ocean_regions.description: Enclosed marginal sea experiencing amplified thermal warming at 2.4x the global open-ocean average, triggering recurrent marine heatwaves.

ocean_regions.name: North Atlantic Subpolar Gyre
ocean_regions.description: High-latitude region critical to Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) deep water formation and North Atlantic freshening.

ocean_regions.name: Arabian Sea (Western Indian Ocean)
ocean_regions.description: Monsoon-driven upwelling basin hosting the world's thickest open-ocean oxygen minimum zone (OMZ) and widespread seasonal algal blooms.

bangladesh_districts.name: Dhaka
bangladesh_districts.description: Dense urban core and capital region exhibiting pronounced urban heat island expansion, rapid wetland infill, and impervious surface warming.

bangladesh_districts.name: Chittagong
bangladesh_districts.description: Primary southeastern maritime port and coastal interface bordering the Bay of Bengal, vulnerable to storm surge and flash flooding.

bangladesh_districts.name: Sylhet
bangladesh_districts.description: High-rainfall basin directly south of Meghalaya plateau; hosts extensive seasonal Haor wetland ecosystems and tea estates.

bangladesh_districts.name: Khulna (Sundarbans Interface)
bangladesh_districts.description: Southwestern coastal delta anchoring the Sundarbans mangrove biosphere; highly vulnerable to salinity intrusion, cyclones, and tidal floods.

bangladesh_districts.name: Rajshahi (Barind Tract)
bangladesh_districts.description: Northwestern elevated Pleistocene clay terrace experiencing high summer land surface temperatures and recurrent agricultural droughts.

bangladesh_districts.name: Cox's Bazar
bangladesh_districts.description: Southernmost coastal district with the world's longest unbroken natural sandy beach; sensitive to coastal erosion and hill deforestation.

bangladesh_districts.name: Barisal
bangladesh_districts.description: Intricate estuarine river network of the lower Ganges-Brahmaputra-Meghna confluence; fertile rice-producing delta exposed to tidal flooding.

bangladesh_districts.name: Rangpur
bangladesh_districts.description: Northern agrarian plain traversed by the Teesta and Brahmaputra rivers; subject to extreme cold waves in winter and riverbank erosion in monsoon.
